description_sq:
Shesim apartament 2+1 prane Qendres se Tiranes tek Rruga e Kavajes.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 2 te nje godine 7 kateshe pa ashensor .
Organizohet nga korridori i cili ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes se bashku me kuzhine dhe dalje ne ballkon, 2 dhomat e gjumi ku njera prej te cilave me ballkon dhe nje tualet.
Investimi ne apartament eshte bere 5 vitet e fundit dhe eshte teper cilesor dhe komod.
Ky apartament mund te perdoret per banim ose investim afatgjate.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet ofron te gjithe facilitet e nevojshme per nje jetese teper komode.
Per me teper informacion, ju lutemi na kontaktoni!!! bot125985
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1 NEAR THE CENTER!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment near the Center of Tirana on Rruga e Kavaje. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a 7-story building without an elevator. It is organized by the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen and exit to the balcony, the 2 bedrooms, one of which has a balcony and a bathroom. The investment in the apartment was made in the last 5 years and is very high quality and comfortable. This apartment can be used for residence or long-term investment. The area in which it is located offers all the necessary facilities for a very comfortable life. For more information, please contact us!!! bot125985
